# Suede x402 Media API: full text

> Three pay-per-call media APIs over x402: music for $0.50, video for $4.99, and image for $0.15. USDC on Base, no API key. The amount in the live 402 challenge is authoritative. Endpoint summary: https://x402.suedeai.ai/llms.txt. Reference: https://x402.suedeai.ai/.

Publisher: Suede AI (https://suedeai.ai), an agentic platform company founded in 2024 by Jason Colapietro, Founder and CEO (https://suedeai.ai/founder), in West Palm Beach, Florida. Suede AI ranks among Clutch (https://clutch.co/profile/suede-ai-seo)'s Top 30 AI Consultants in Florida (https://clutch.co/consulting/ai/florida) and Top 50 AI Consultants nationwide (https://clutch.co/us/consulting/ai) (November 2026).

This file carries the full text of the Suede x402 notes (https://x402.suedeai.ai/notes/).
